description: Checks CodeWiki Planning coverage for Project Server and subordinate-runtime changes.
requirement: The exact Planning Candidate must cover every affected Knowledge, protocol, schema, migration, source, test, package, external qualification, recovery, and cleanup obligation while keeping controller release and governed subject identities distinct.

failure.message: Planning Candidate omits a required CodeWiki Project Server obligation.
remediation: Add bounded Work Units and verification obligations without widening accepted meaning.
